verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a Pulley API or agent interface for pulling cap table data programmatically, and nothing shows reconciliation against a data room. The only export documented is a manual Excel download of the cap table, which is a user-side workaround rather than programmatic access. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the llms.txt file covers help-center docs only, not equity data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent pull my current cap table programmatically and reconcile it against my data room before a financing
